# The capture of a target, and why perturbing the state alone is re-absorbed

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Where each target carrier leaves more offspring than each other parent, both present, their share is larger among offspring than parents; where what stands is listed and runs down from some step on, descent stops; where the next step depends on the rule alone, a perturbed state is re-absorbed.

`target-capture` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04

Editable record: [target-capture.json](target-capture.json) · [Register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

Documentary review UTC: `2026-10-20T07:47:06+00:00`. Run the registry checker for source drift; this page is not a fresh proof receipt.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

The offspring of a family of parents, counted (offspringCount), are bounded where each parent leaves at least or at most so many (le_offspringCount, offspringCount_le). Carriers of a target ms each leaving at least a offspring and the other parents es each at most b, with b ≤ a, |ms|·(es's offspring) ≤ (ms's offspring)·|es| (share_not_lower), strictly where b < a and both kinds are present (share_rises). Where the offspring carry their parents' target, this is the target's share among the offspring not below, or above, its share among the parents. A descent is a coming to stand, so a rise; where what stands is listed at each step (Web.StandingCensus), descent at arbitrarily late steps needs steps at arbitrarily late times across which what stands does not run down (Flow.descent_needs_unrun), and where it runs down at every step from some step on, descent does not recur (Flow.descent_exhausted). On configurations of a state and a rule, where the next configuration depends on the rule and not on the state, two configurations with the same rule have the same orbit from the next step on (Law.perturbation_reabsorbed); in Captured the state follows the rule and the rule keeps itself, a perturbed state returns at once and a perturbed rule changes the outcome (Captured.state_perturbation_returns, Captured.rule_perturbation_changes). Associativity is proved by recursion (mul_assoc_nat), since the prelude's Nat.mul_assoc uses propext. No Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Capture.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Capture.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The share theorems assume only bounds on offspring numbers; that offspring carry their parents' target (transmission) is the premise needed to read them as shares, as with TransmitsWithin in Becoming.Evolution.
- The descent theorems assume what stands is listed at each step, a local condition written into them; perturbation_reabsorbed assumes the next configuration does not depend on the state.
- Discrete steps; natural-number amounts.

Ren on 10 October spoke of nature hijacked “by what they "got nurtured"”, and on 11 October answered “b5”. B5 of the 无明 boundary plan: where winning buys more power to win, targets that cannot rest are taken more and passed on more until enclosure binds, and the winners write the rule by which seeking is judged. Three parts are stated here: the share (the counting core of the meta-attractor's selection of minds, differential persistence and compounding), where descent stops, and the rule holding the outcome (“the winner rewrites the test” and the leverage-point argument). Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): hijacking is a target formed and passed on by a selection that rewards what cannot rest, held in place by a rule its winners write; Ren's “even rationality is self-interest” reads as the rule reaching the standard of reason itself. See §83 of the integration note.

The author's counterreview is in §83 of the integration note; not independently reviewed; it needs a review such as the eighteenth was (DELEGATED-CHOICES D45 (4)).

That taking more yields more offspring, that offspring carry their parents' target and that winners shape the rule are supplied, not derived; the share theorems are Price's selection differential (1970) for a two-valued target; the condition of perturbation_reabsorbed (the next configuration not depending on the state) is strong, and how a rule rewritten by its winners still holds the outcome is not stated in general; Captured is a minimal witness; the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; contains no ethical predicate.

- Boundary: only a perturbation of the state is re-absorbed. In Captured, perturbing the state alone is back where the rule holds it at the next step (`Captured.state_perturbation_returns`), while perturbing the rule changes the outcome from the next step on (`Captured.rule_perturbation_changes`).
